title: Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Analyst
description:
Job Description
Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Analyst

The CIAM Analyst will support customer identity and access management initiatives by gathering business requirements, analyzing application onboarding needs, documenting identity flows, and coordinating CIAM implementations across business and technology teams. The role will act as a bridge between application owners, security teams, architects, and engineering teams to ensure successful onboarding of customer-facing applications onto CIAM platforms such as Ping Identity and Strivacity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements for CIAM onboarding initiatives.
  • Conduct application assessments to identify authentication, authorization, registration, profile management, and federation requirements.
  • Create process flows, use cases, user stories, and functional specifications.
  • Support onboarding of web, mobile, API, and partner applications onto CIAM platforms.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, security teams, and application owners throughout project delivery.
  • Assist in testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production readiness activities.
  • Track onboarding progress, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Support compliance and audit activities related to customer identity and access management.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IAM Analyst, or CIAM Analyst.
  • Understanding of CIAM concepts including SSO, MFA, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, and customer registration journeys.
  • Experience creating business requirements, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Ping Identity, Strivacity, Okta, Auth0, or ForgeRock.
  • Knowledge of customer onboarding, identity verification, consent management, and privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, or Retail industries

title: Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Architect
description:
Job Description
Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Architect

Roles & Responsibilities
Lead the onboarding, integration, and implementation of customer-facing applications onto CIAM platforms such as Ping Identity and Strivacity. Define identity architecture, authentication, authorization, and customer lifecycle management solutions to deliver secure, scalable, and seamless digital experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement CIAM solutions using Ping Identity and Strivacity platforms.
  • Lead application onboarding and migration to centralized CIAM services.
  • Define authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, federation, and passwordless access strategies.
  • Integrate applications using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, SCIM, and REST APIs.
  • Collaborate with business, security, and development teams to gather requirements and define target architectures.
  • Establish customer identity governance, access policies, and compliance controls.
  • Support CIAM platform configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  • Develop onboarding standards, architecture patterns, and implementation best practices.
  • Provide technical leadership during solution design, testing, and production deployment.

Required Skills:

  • Strong experience with Ping Identity, Strivacity, or similar CIAM platforms.
  • Expertise in OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, MFA, federation, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience integrating web, mobile, and API-based applications with CIAM solutions.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, API security, and identity governance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and solution architecture skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
  • Knowledge of customer onboarding, KYC, and digital identity verification processes.
  • Relevant CIAM or identity certifications.

title: Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Engineer
description:
Job Description
Customer Identity & Access Management (CIAM) Engineer

We are seeking a skilled CIAM Engineer to support the implementation, configuration, and onboarding of customer-facing applications onto CIAM platforms such as Ping Identity and Strivacity. The role involves designing and supporting authentication, authorization, federation, and customer registration solutions while ensuring security, scalability, and an optimal user experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Configure and support CIAM solutions using Ping Identity and/or Strivacity platforms.
  • Onboard web, mobile, and API-based applications to enterprise CIAM services.
  • Implement Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML integrations.
  • Develop and maintain customer registration, login, password management, and profile management journeys.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, federation, and access-related issues.
  • Collaborate with application teams, security teams, and architects to deliver secure identity solutions.
  • Support CIAM platform upgrades, enhancements, and operational activities.
  • Create technical documentation, onboarding guides, and integration standards.

Required Skills:

  • 3–7 years of IAM/CIAM experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Ping Identity and/or Strivacity platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT, and SCIM.
  • Experience integrating applications using REST APIs and identity protocols.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ping Identity certifications.
  • Experience with customer identity lifecycle management and adaptive authentication.
  • Experience in Banking, Financial Services.
